purpose: Frozen source, cohort, label, and leakage audit for the v2.5 Mikl published-model reconstruction.
locks: TDP-43 locked outcomes and astrocyte outcomes were not read.

paper.title: A massively parallel reporter assay reveals focused and broadly encoded RNA localization signals in neurons

official_repository.note: The repository supplies the official library-design and mapping code but not the paper's machine-learning fit. Model semantics are reconstructed from the peer-reviewed Methods.

paper_cohort_reproduction.filter: number of reads - CAD > 500 and number of reads - Neuro-2a > 500; one deterministic first source row per 150-nt insert

labels.neurite_positive: CAD logFC > 0 and CAD p < 0.05 and Neuro-2a logFC > 0 and Neuro-2a p < 0.05
labels.soma_positive: CAD logFC < 0 and CAD p < 0.05 and Neuro-2a logFC < 0 and Neuro-2a p < 0.05
